issues.on_page: Line 24 Ending Balance 24,399.19 = line 26 Net Cash 8,952.09 + line 27 Investments 15,447.10
issues.issue: beginning_cash (line 3, 25,361.64) and ending_cash (line 24, 24,399.19) already include the certificate of deposit, which is also recorded in beginning_investments (15,428.00) and ending_investments (15,447.10). Adding cash + investments downstream would count the CD twice. The notes say this, but the 'cash' figures are really cash plus investments.
Cemetery Fund local receipts are probably cemetery fees or lot sales, but the page doesn't say so. Keeping 'other' with a review note is defensible.

issues.on_page: Line 29 General Government, Street Fund 4,361.10 / Cemetery Fund 1,628.95
issues.issue: Street and Cemetery Fund spending is printed on the General Government line. Keeping it as printed follows the as-printed rule, but by function it would be streets/highways and health/welfare (detail[6] is the same case).
